title: Fixed Open Drop-Front Secretary Cabinet
description: One original complete fixed-open drop-front secretary cabinet: a wide forward horizontal writing leaf rests on two projecting under-leaf bearers at the foot of a true slope-front upper storage cavity. Two transverse hinge barrels mark its fixed lower pivot. Thick sloping side cheeks, rear wall, short crown and actual open pigeonholes form the upper bureau; a continuous thick lower case contains a shelf behind two closed front leaves, on four finite feet. All geometry newly authored, not the old fixed-top work cabinet or sloped teacher lectern resized. Four opaque constant PBR materials, no textures. One whole prop, zero scenes. Only the displayed fixed pose: no closing sweep, furniture motion, actual hinge mechanics, load, comfort, ergonomics, manufacture, stability or safety certification.
